description.en: Injects one short prompt section: direct access stays the default, and only after a network call actually fails should the agent consider that a local proxy may be running. A companion text file next to the plugin carries proxy addresses that worked on this machine, so one session's discovery is visible to the next.
description.zh-cn: 注入一段很短的提示词：默认直连，只有请求真的失败后，才提醒 agent「本机可能开着代理」。插件目录下另有一个文本文件，记录这台机器上试通过的代理地址，让一个会话的发现能被下一个会话读到。
